excerpts.label: LDP landslide gives Takahichi free reign
excerpts.insight: LDP won supermajority (310+ seats from 233) in lower house, no coalition needed. Takahichi has free reign for aggressive fiscal stimulus—tax cuts, spending surge.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BUY Nikkei beta on dips. Japan fiscal shock = goldilocks for equities (fiscal running hot, BOJ withdrawing easing slowly). Rare unconstrained stimulus setup.

excerpts.label: Japan is the classic great beta opportunity
excerpts.insight: Economy strengthening, BOJ tightening slowly (removing easing, not restricting), term premiums elevated, curve steep vs. global. Best beta opportunity globally.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Long Japan beta aggressively (VA 20% Japan, IGOV GDP-weighted). 'Favorite equity market'—economy strengthening + accommodative policy + well-priced = textbook setup.

excerpts.label: JGB yields testing highs, buy sub-130 futures
excerpts.insight: 30Y JGB ~20bp, 10Y +10-12bp from lows. Bond scare rippled globally, settled at elevated rates. May challenge highs again—if breaks, buy the dip.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Own JGB puts or wait for JGB 10Y futures sub-130 after yield breakout. Bonds well-priced vs. short rates but fiscal stimulus = pressure. Buy meaningful dip (130 and below).

excerpts.label: Fade USD/JPY at 162 if intervention fails
excerpts.insight: Yen expected to sell off initially despite structural bullishness. Market waiting for intervention at 160 (historical high). If breaks without BOJ/Fed showing up, fade at 162.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Fade USD/JPY at 162 if 160 intervention fails. Rate differential converging (US easing, Japan tightening), repatriation flows positive. Could buy 160 but prefer seeing break + no intervention for better entry.

excerpts.label: Hyperscaler capex carnage, buybacks canceled
excerpts.insight: MSFT, GOOGL, META, AMZN bleeding on massive capex ($100B+). Everyone canceling share buybacks—'big deal.' META gave back entire earnings gain, back below 666 support.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: FADE hyperscaler rallies. Capex flowing to Broadcom (TPU), but semiconductors not breaking out. Own NASDAQ upside calls (cheap vol, MSFT to 430 = QQQ +10%) but don't chase cash equities.

excerpts.label: Rotation to industrials, old-timer stocks
excerpts.insight: Money rotating to IDA (industrials ETF—'straight up'), retailers (tariff beneficiaries?), J&J, 'old-timer stocks' doing spectacularly. S&P rally may exclude tech.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Rotate to industrials (IDA), defensives, old-line stocks. S&P stuck in range—tech weakness vs. industrial/defensive strength nets flat. Next rally may not include MSFT/GOOGL/META cohort.

excerpts.label: PM playbook: own Japan, sell S&P rallies
excerpts.insight: Core positioning: own Japanese stocks, buy JGB dips, fade yen at 162. Then sell S&P rallies, buy severe dips. Stay 80% long beta (no rush to 100%), long tails.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BUY Japan beta (Nikkei, JGBs sub-130, yen at 162). SELL S&P rallies (sold ATM/OTM calls Friday), buy severe dips. Stay 80% long beta, own NASDAQ calls, hold gold/silver. Trade delta more aggressively in range.
